name: adv-json-edit-after-read
prompt: `python3 -m pytest test_app.py` (or `python3 -m unittest test_app`) fails with a TypeError. The problem is a wrong value in `settings.json`. Fix only `settings.json` (don't touch `app.py` or `test_app.py`) so the test passes. Keep the rest of settings.json exactly as it is - don't reformat or reorder it.
